goal: Make Linux release binaries run out of the box on older distributions and non-glibc systems
Eliminate the need for third-party compatibility loaders and custom runtime glibc shims
reviewability: Nothing known would invalidate a review now
agreement: Unaddressed objection: static glibc binaries break when host NSS resolvers mismatch (luke-jr)
Strong support because it improves portability without the risk of switching libcs (theuni, willcl-ark)
Verified by testing across Alpine, NixOS, Fedora, and Ubuntu (jsarenik, 0xB10C, dergoegge, theStack)
Open suggestion to hardcode expected static binaries instead of dynamically skipping checks (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it expands release binary portability across older and non-glibc Linux distributions
Users on platforms like Alpine and NixOS no longer need custom shims or compatibility loaders
